paragraphs.text: Jiang Yanggu is an amnesiac human , and former Planeswalker , whose earliest memories are of Shenmeng , and is always accompanied by a sapient dog named Mowu .

He has power over the creatures of the forest and can magically enhance their strength. Yanggu can planeswalk with his dog as part of his planeswalking ability. Concept art from the development of the Global Series shows he is 5'5" (165cm) tall.
Jiang Yanggu is centered in green mana.

After waking up with no memories, he didn't know his name or family. He renamed himself Yanggu (literally "valley where sun rises" ) after the first place he can remember. To save the Jiuli Clan, which was haunted by plague, Yanggu ventured into the Ten Wizards Mountain for a solution. Here he battled, and later befriended, the mysterious water mage Mu Yanling . With Yanling's help, Yanggu tackled the threat of the plague. To find out who he really was, he went onto the journey of expedition with Mu Yanling.

Jiang Yanggu and Mu Yanling were lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon , and immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun . Alongside many other planeswalkers and Ravnicans, he fought against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde .

During the invasion, the trapped planeswalkers got together with Ravnican leaders to strategize. At Jace 's recommendation, they decided to split up into teams to focus on specific tasks. Ajani , Huatli , Jiang Yanggu, and Mu Yanling volunteered to help protect and rescue civilians. With the help of Vraska and the Golgari Swarm , they were able to evacuate many civilians to the tunnels beneath the city, where they would be safe from the Dreadhorde.

Yanggu was one of the few planeswalkers who chose to remain on Ravnica after Chandra disabled the Immortal Sun, helping the Gatewatch in their fight against Bolas. He and Yanling survived the battle, and they were among the first planeswalkers to leave Ravnica after Bolas' defeat, with Mowu turning into a stone statue before both he and Yanggu disappeared.
Yanggu lost his spark during the Desparkening , but continues traveling with Mowu through the Omenpaths .

In the Echoverse , Yanggu's spark never ignited. When Mowu was killed by unknown assailants, Yanggu cast aside his peaceful ways, craving only vengeance. He realized that no amount of healing could mend his broken plane, and that those who preyed upon the innocent needed to be removed from it before they could break it further.

Yanggu wandered Shenmeng in search of those responsible for Mowu's death, defending those who were too helpless to save themselves. But no matter how many people he saved, and no matter how many enemies he defeated, he could never wash away the pain of losing Mowu.
